transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net digital app support, my name is Laura. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Laura. I am trying to pay my monthly broadband bill of forty-five pounds through the My S-Net mobile app on my iPhone, but every time I tap 'Pay with Apple Pay', the app crashes straight back to the home screen! My bill is due today and I don't want to get hit with a late payment charge!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can help you resolve that payment application crash, Jonas. First let's complete account verification. What is your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Jonas Lindholm, 59 St Peter's Road, Reading, RG6 1PQ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account, Jonas?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what I understand is you are attempting to settle your forty-five pound bill via Apple Pay in the My S-Net mobile app on your iPhone, but the app crashes instantly upon initiating the transaction, and you need this payment processed today to avoid late fees, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that. It's been crashing since yesterday evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What iOS software version is currently installed on your iPhone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I updated to iOS 18.0.1 on Sunday night.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what version of the My S-Net mobile app are you running?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Version 4.12.0 from the App Store.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The iOS 18 security framework introduced an updated PassKit token sandboxing protocol that causes a memory null pointer exception in app version 4.12.0 if cached wallet credentials are stale.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why wasn't the app updated before iOS 18 launched? S-Net should test its software with Apple developer betas! It's so frustrating being locked out of paying my own bill!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our engineering team pushed app version 4.12.2 to the App Store yesterday afternoon to patch the PassKit integration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I checked the App Store this morning and it didn't show an update button.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously Apple CDN app caches take up to twenty-four hours to propagate across all regional server nodes unless manually refreshed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do I force the update or clear the crash then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of this and guide you through clearing the stale PassKit cache and completing your payment. Bear with me for sixty seconds while I waive any automated late fee flags on your billing account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Jonas. I have placed a forty-eight-hour fee freeze on your account so no late penalty can trigger.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we have the app open, would you like to set up a monthly Direct Debit so you don't have to manually pay each month?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I set up Direct Debit directly inside the app?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, under Payment Methods, tap 'Add Direct Debit'. It links with your UK bank account in about sixty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would save me having to remember to pay every month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you are protected by the Direct Debit Guarantee with automatic payment receipts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll link my bank account this evening after work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can also view your live broadband speed test and network devices from the home tab.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I saw the speed test widget, very sleek interface.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the app supports FaceID auto-login on iOS 18 so you don't have to retype your password.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, FaceID worked instantly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And future app updates will install automatically if background app refresh is on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have automatic updates enabled.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for protecting the account from fees Laura.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now on your iPhone, open the App Store and tap your user profile icon in the top right corner.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped my profile icon in the App Store.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Pull down firmly from the top of the screen to force a manual refresh of the pending updates list.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pulling down... Spinning wheel appeared... Oh! 'My S-Net version 4.12.2' just appeared under Upcoming Automatic Updates with an 'Update' button!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap 'Update' to install the patched release.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping Update... Progress circle is filling up... Installed!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before you launch the payment, you are running iOS 18.0.1 on that iPhone, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, iOS 18.0.1.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now open the My S-Net app and log in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening app... FaceID logged in smoothly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap on the 'Bills & Payments' tab, and tap 'Pay £45.00 Now'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping Pay £45.00... Apple Pay sheet popped up with my card! Double-clicking side button for FaceID... Chime! Green checkmark!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the app screen update to show 'Payment of £45.00 Received - Balance: £0.00'?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! 'Payment Successful. Current Balance: £0.00'. It didn't crash at all!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the PassKit token handshake is fully resolved with the new app build.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That was so quick and painless to fix. Thank you so much Laura.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing email address on file, it's jonas dot lindholm at reading dot org dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have dispatched the official PDF receipt for your forty-five pound payment to that address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Received the payment confirmation email already.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your app or billing account that I can assist you with today, Jonas?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Laura, that sorted out the payment perfectly. Have a great day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Jonas, and enjoy the rest of your week.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Laura, goodbye.
